sentence: This project builds a light-based method that maps temperature at the nanoscale using luminescent upconverting nanoparticles.
This project builds a framework that uses real-world cyber breaches as case studies to teach cybersecurity, along with virtual lab platforms.
This project tries to make quantum error correction more practical by focusing on computational errors and how noise is inferred from measurements.
This project studies how organic compounds in indoor air interact with airborne dust and what chemical products result.
This project builds a system that lets welding robots sense the molten weld pool and adapt to changing conditions to keep weld quality consistent.
This project develops ways to keep driver-assist systems safe while they learn a driver's habits and preferences.
This project studies how to keep autonomous control systems safe when they work with humans in uncertain conditions and repeated interactions.
This project studies how the spread of trees into grasslands and savannas changes the amount of water in the soil.
This project studies how oxidation happens at the surface of organic aerosol particles, using mass spectrometry.
This project builds computer methods to predict the shapes that DNA and RNA take and how they bind to proteins.
This project builds a software library that lets scientists stream only as much data as they need from large simulations.
This project builds a statistical tool that helps computers understand three-dimensional scenes using synthetic data and Bayesian theory.
This project studies how rockfishes split into many species by looking at their genomes, habitats, body shape, size and color.
This project builds a machine learning framework that automatically selects useful features for prediction and applies it to genomic data to study diseases.
This project studies how soil movement on hillslopes affects how ice and carbon are stored in permafrost soils.
